description: Atlyn Radar Chart visualizes multivariate performance across radial axes, making it easy to compare several metrics for one or two series at a glance. Plot a category field around the axes and one or two value series to reveal strengths, gaps, and balance across dimensions. Key features: - Single or comparison (two-series) radar/spider plots - Configurable axes, gridlines, fill opacity, line width, and markers - Data labels and rich hover tooltips - Formatting pane control over colors, legend, and axis range - High-contrast and report-theme aware; keyboard accessible Common uses: competitive profiling, product and feature benchmarking, capability or skills scoring, survey and assessment results, and segment comparisons. Interactivity: click a point to select and cross-filter other visuals, hover for tooltips, and right-click for the standard context menu. The included sample report demonstrates a polished business scenario with interactive filtering and configurable formatting, plus tips on setup. Licensing: This visual is free to download and evaluate from Microsoft AppSource. Continued commercial use requires a paid AtlynCo subscription after a 30-day free trial. See https://www.atlynco.com/pricing for plans and pricing. Microsoft does not manage licensing or billing for this visual; subscriptions are handled independently by AtlynCo.
